title: Record receipt response
description: Response returned when a receipt is recorded.

data.description: The Delivery the receipt is recorded against — echoed from the path on `POST /deliveries/{deliveryId}/receipt`, or a new empty Delivery minted by `POST /receipts`.

deliveryId.title: Delivery ID
deliveryId.description: Unique identifier for a delivery, minted by the server on `POST /deliveries`.
